contract.intended_consumer: Governed repositories executing work graphs under plans owned by another registered repository
contract.outcome: A qualified cross-repository plan validates from its exact authority repository while the work graph and mutation claim remain bound to the exact target repository.

canonical_journey.starting_state: Project Meta owns complete Plan 249 and AES owns its ready Plan 249 work graph at clean remote-default revisions.
canonical_journey.input: The qualified plan reference, explicit plan-authority root/revision, AES target root/revision, work graph, work unit, and native session identity.
canonical_journey.action: Create the AES claimed worktree and session under project-meta#249.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Plan integrity resolves in Project Meta, work-unit and mutation authority resolve in AES, both revision identities persist, and the AES worktree starts without a proxy plan.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: The plan is searched for in AES, either authority is guessed or lost, or a denied probe leaves a branch, claim, or worktree.

request.approval_text: Brian authorized the bounded Plan 130 repair after the Plan 249 cross-repository claim defect was reproduced
